title: Cannot clear database inside a transaction
body:
<!--
  Please follow the template.  If you don't, your issue may be closed.

  Have a question?  This is the TypeORM issue tracker - and not the right place
  for general support or questions.  Instead, check the "Support" Documentation
  on the best places to ask questions!

  https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/blob/master/docs/support.md
-->

## Issue Description

`queryRunner.clearDatabase()` fails if trying to run inside a transaction.

### Expected Behavior

<!--
  A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.
-->

It clears the database inside the transaction, then operations can be performed inside the transaction on a temporarily empty database, and that transaction can later be reverted


### Actual Behavior
It throws `TransactionAlreadyStartedError` when trying to `clearDatabase` inside a transaction
<!--
  A clear and concise description of what actually happened.

  Please wrap any error messages or output in code tags, instead of images.
-->

```
// TransactionAlreadyStartedError: Transaction already started for the given connection, commit current transaction before starting a new one.
```


### Steps to Reproduce

<!--
  Your bug will be investigated much faster if we can run your code and it doesn't
  have dependencies other than TypeORM. Issues without reproduction steps or
  code examples may be closed as not actionable.

  Please try to provide a Minimal, Complete, and Verifiable example.
  http://stackoverflow.com/help/mcve
-->

1. Connect to a databsae
2. Start Transaction
3. `clearDatabase`
4. It throws `TransactionAlreadyStartedError`

```typescript
const connection = await createConnection();
const queryRunner = connection.createQueryRunner();
await queryRunner.startTransaction();
await queryRunner.clearDatabase();
// ^ This fails with `TransactionAlreadyStartedError`
```

### My Environment

<!--
  Please add any other relevant dependencies to this table at the end.
  For example: Electron, React Native, or NestJS.
-->

| Dependency          | Version  |
| ---                 | ---      |
| Operating System    | macOS |
| Node.js version     | 16.13.1  | <!-- run `node -v` to obtain this -->
| Typescript version  | 4.5.4 | <!-- run `npm list typescript` to obtain this -->
| TypeORM version     |0.2.41  | <!-- run `npm list typeorm` to obtain this -->


### Additional Context

<!--
  Add any other context about the bug report here.
-->
I want to `clearDatabase` inside a transaction, so I could get a temporary blank slate database, and then run migrations inside the same transaction, so I can determine what tables are missing after running all migrations regardless of, and without modifying the initial state of the database
